nodes.label: Input: nums (List[int])
nodes.action: ctx['nums'] = ctx['arg0']; ctx['n'] = len(ctx['nums']); ctx['dp'] = [0] * ctx['n']; ctx['i'] = 0

nodes.label: dp[i] = nums[i] + max(0, max dp[j] over j < i with nums[j] - j <= nums[i] - i)
nodes.action:
ctx['dp'][ctx['i']] = ctx['nums'][ctx['i']]
b = ctx['nums'][ctx['i']] - ctx['i']
best = 0
j = 0
while j < ctx['i']:
    if ctx['nums'][j] - j <= b and ctx['dp'][j] > best:
        best = ctx['dp'][j]
    j += 1
ctx['dp'][ctx['i']] += best
